Posted 'Coruscant Jedi Council' dested Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber; 'I Did IT' dested the Epic Event I Did It!; 'Naked Threepio' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing.

Posted 'Tatooine Qui-Gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); 'Reflections 3 Qui-Gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn, Jedi Master; 'Qui-Gon's Saber' dested the Reflections III weapon Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (closest to the posted name; the Tatooine Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber also fits); 'Luke's Saber' dested Luke's Lightsaber; 'Jar Jar's Electrople' dested Jar Jar's Electropole.
Posted 'Radiant 7' dested Radiant VII; 'Queen's Ship' dested Queen's Royal Starship; 'Falcon' dested Millennium Falcon.

Posted 'EPP Han' and 'EPP Chewie' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol and Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'Pissed Off Chewie' dested Chewie, Enraged; 'Lando, Scoundrel' dested Lando Calrissian, Scoundrel; 'Jedi Knight Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight.

Posted 'Brisky Mornin Munchen' dested Brisky Morning Munchen; 'Bith Shuffle / Desperate Reach' and 'Out of Commission / Transmission Terminated' dested the combo Interrupts; 'A Step Backwards' dested A Step Backward; 'Gimme a Lift' dested Gimme A Lift!.
Shields as posted: 'A Tragedy Has Occured' dested A Tragedy Has Occurred; 'Ournee Ta' dested Ounee Ta; 'Do or Do Not' dested Do, Or Do Not; each is the Reflections III Defensive Shield.
The description calls it an 'award winning' deck but names no tournament or finish.
